## Business problem

What user or industry outcome does this change improve?

## Change

Summarize the implementation and its boundaries.

## Security, privacy, and governance

Describe effects on data handling, residency, access, auditability, model/runtime trust, and backward compatibility. Write `No material change` where applicable.

## Verification

List the commands and scenarios run, including failure paths.

## Checklist

- [ ] I excluded secrets, personal data, customer data, regulated content, model weights, and generated artifacts.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] I updated documentation or explained why no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] I considered rollback and compatibility for existing local deployments.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`).
